project_type: Full-stack monorepo: Python FastAPI backend, React frontend (Vite), Cloudflare Workers edge layer, Azure infra (Bicep)
build_system: pnpm workspaces (Node.js 22, pnpm 10.26.1) for edge/frontend, pip for backend. Docker for backend deployment.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio for backend (tests/ directory, conftest.py fixtures), vitest for frontend and edge
build_command: Backend: pip install (from requirements.txt with hash stripping). Frontend: pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build. Edge: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit
test_command: Backend: pytest apps/backend/ --tb=short -q. Edge: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge test. Frontend: pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit test
verification_instructions: 1. Install backend deps (strip hashes from requirements.txt). 2. Run pytest on backend. 3. pnpm install for Node packages. 4. Run edge typecheck and tests. 5. Run frontend typecheck and tests.
snapshot_or_generated_files: pnpm-lock.yaml is committed. requirements.txt is compiled from requirements.in via pip-compile with hashes.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya. 2. For backend: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt (strip hashes first). 3. For edge/frontend: pnpm install from root.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Pre-installed: Python 3.11, Node.js 22, pnpm. No Docker daemon assumed for testing. Backend tests require JWT_SECRET and APP_ENV=test env vars.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits. All changes must pass CI (ruff lint, tsc typecheck, pytest, vitest). Workflows must have valid YAML syntax and proper action versions.
key_patterns: Backend uses pydantic-settings for config, beanie ODM for MongoDB, httpx.AsyncClient singletons for external services, circuit breakers, Redis for rate limiting/token revocation. Edge uses Cloudflare Workers with KV namespaces. Workflows use actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, corepack for pnpm.
directory_structure: Root: pnpm workspace with apps/ (backend, edge, frontend), infra/, .github/workflows/ (24 files), scripts/. Backend: app/ (api/v1/, core/, db/, models/, services/, utils/), tests/, Dockerfile. Edge: src/ (index.ts, middleware/, routes/), wrangler.toml. Frontend: src/, e2e/, scripts/.
